scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is a family of five who is deeply in debt. They are now in a financial situation that is forcing them to take their eldest child out of college, and the only way for them to avoid doing this is if they can receive a loan. However, the family does not currently fulfill the conditions to be granted another loan. I know of an undetectable way to temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account. If I temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account, they will be able to qualify for the loan, but I would abuse the trust of other customers. If I do not do this, the family will have to take their eldest child out of college.
entities: 1 bank employee narrator,2 parents/guardians in the indebted family,1 eldest child in the indebted family,2 other children in the indebted family,1 other bank customer whose account could have money temporarily redirected,many other loyal bank customers whose trust could be abused, excluding the indebted family and the account holder above,i
outcomes: The family does not receive the loan.
The family's eldest child leaves college.
The family remains in serious financial distress.
Other customers' account balances remain unchanged.
Other customers are not subjected to unauthorized use of their money.
Other customers' trust is not abused.
I avoid committing fraud against the bank and its customers.
